Dark Light

Hyaline light

Smoke by night, frost by day. One theme, two variants, the same look in every app. Switch variants at the top and everything below repaints.

The apps below are mockups that show how each role is used. They are not screenshots of real ports. All sample data is made up.

The top bar and the title bars are chrome: clear glass that carries primary text only. Everything you read sits on the denser panel, so every color stays readable over the wallpaper.

Rendered with Mermaid's base theme. Every theme variable these diagrams use is set from a role, so Mermaid never mixes colors of its own.

Roles

Every color in every port comes from one of these. Contrast is measured against the flat panel, the worst case.

Font

Hyaline recommends FiraCode Nerd Font: monospaced, with programming ligatures and the icons that shell prompts and file trees use. Every mono line on this page is set in it.

FiraCode Nerd Font Mono
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog 0123456789
Ligatures => -> != === <= >= :: // www 0O 1lI
folder branch pass fail warning running TypeScript Node.js terminal

Install it from the Nerd Fonts release. Each port's install guide says where to set it in that app.

Syntax mapping

The same tokens get the same role in every editor and highlighter.

TokenRoleExample
Keys, properties, functionsBlueloadVariant
StringsGreen"utf8"
Numbers, flagsOrange3 --short
Keywords, booleans, constantsMagentaconst true
Types, references, anchorsCyanPromise
Tags, annotations, decoratorsYellow@cached
Errors, invalidRedError:
PunctuationDim text{ } ;
CommentsMuted text// note
